{{Quote|Tayari Rook claims to lead his own clan! He destroyed ''my'' clan with his slander, then dares to raise up his mishmash of slavers and pirates and call them 'Clan Rook'! And no one has challenged them!|[[Akaavi Spar]]|<ref name="TOR:CR" />}}
'''Clan Rook''' was a criminal organization active during the [[Galactic War]] that posed as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan. It was led by the criminal [[Tayari Rook]], who made unsubstantiated claims of being a Mandalorian himself.

==History==
{{Quote|They had no honor. The smart ones ran and survived. The foolish ones are fertilizing Hutta.|Akaavi Spar|<ref name="TOR:CR" />}}
The so-called Clan Rook comprised a number of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] operating as a clan of Mandalorians.<ref name="TOR:CR" /> They served under Tayari Rook, a self-proclaimed Mandalorian,<ref name="TOR:TToTR">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Akaavi Spar|The Trail of Tayari Rook}}</ref> who [[Death/Legends|killed]] or dishonored any who would expose the truth of their organization to the true Mandalorians,<ref name="TOR:CR" /> who would be honor-bound to kill the pretenders.<ref name="TOR:TToTR" />

Clan Rook and its leader were responsible for the downfall of [[Clan Spar]], a Mandalorian clan that Tayari Rook slandered in order to gain a favorable contract with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Members of the Mandalorian [[Clan Lone|Lone clan]] eventually joined with Clan Rook, after they were dishonored for not aiding Clan Spar when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] came to capture and execute them for supposed crimes against the Empire. Clan Spar's only known survivor, a young [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] by the name of [[Akaavi Spar]], eventually learned of Tayari Rook's involvement in the death of her people. She tracked the group to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where they were camped, working jobs for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Spar attacked shortly thereafter, killing Tayari and any member of Clan Rook that didn't escape her assault.<ref name="TOR:CR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Rook was introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]]. Tayari and the other members of his makeshift clan primarily served as antagonists to Akaavi Spar, an [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|NPC]] companion to players of the [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] class. Discovering Clan Rook's responsibility for the death of her family and subsequently delivering retribution upon them for the injustice is an underlying goal in her character's personal narrative.<ref name="TOR:CR" />

[[File:Clan_Rook.svg|thumb|right|200px|The sigil of the [[canon]]ical [[Clan Rook]]]]
Despite its origins in ''The Old Republic'' as a false Mandalorian clan founded as a pretense for non-Mandalorian criminal activity,<ref name="TOR:CR" /> following the [[2014]] purchase of [[Lucasfilm]] by [[The Walt Disney Company]] and the establishment of a new iteration of ''Star Wars'' [[canon]],<ref name="End of EU">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Clan Rook]] reappeared in the premiere of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''{{'}} [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]], entitled [[Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore|''Heroes of Mandalore'']].<ref name="HoM">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]''</ref> No longer a criminal sect with Mandalorian pretenses operating on Nal Hutta,<ref name="TOR:CR" /> the new incarnation of Clan Rook—as of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]—existed as a legitimate Mandalorian clan living on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], who've pledged their loyalty alongside several other [[Mandalorian clan|clans]] to [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] in pursuit of liberating their [[homeworld]] from the Imperial occupation.<ref name="HoM" />
